title: Raft Consensus with a Minority of Nodes
summary: A technical blog post explaining the Raft consensus algorithm's behavior when dealing with a minority of nodes in a distributed system, addressing edge cases and practical implications for fault-tolerant systems.
problem_solved: Explains how Raft consensus handles scenarios where only a minority subset of cluster nodes participate in leader election or log replication.
why_valuable: Provides critical understanding of distributed consensus behavior for building reliable distributed databases and systems that must maintain consistency despite node failures.
